notes.title: Countdown to the release of “VARLET”
notes.notes:
／

"VARLET"

Only 1⃣ day left until release!!

＼

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/9f8c38d85b708744cecf569fee12417719dd07f8.jpg"]illustration by chooco（@chocoshi3）



To celebrate the upcoming release, we received a special comment from Gakuto Mikumo, who was in charge of the main scenario for the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/3a1a58c78e84afc42afe0736a4429115c0220ca9.png"]

Full message below:

From the moment I heard that the theme of this work would be “the desire for approval,” I’ve been thinking about what “desires” mean to the protagonist and the six companions—what their true “wishes” and “salvation” might be.

 

When those runaway desires bare their fangs at the people around them and even at themselves, what will the protagonists choose to abandon, and what will they decide to embrace?

I hope you will witness their “choices” and the “outcomes” that follow.



Scenario

Gakuto Mikumo

―――――――――――

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/f79924be5d762f1febe1c9c4b2c6a828e5b4b4c4.png"]

Is the world worth saving, even if it costs your own life?

School RPG “VARLET”



A juvenile RPG set in a collapsing academy.



Boys and girls struggling with the question of who they truly are confront the monster called “the desire for approval” lurking within their hearts.



📅 Release Date: August 28, 2025 (JST)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/749fde01c0f5868597cf60230c870ebc46f99124.jpg"]illustration by うさまー（@U_summer07192）



To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’ve received a special message from ITO Ryutaro, who handled the messages from the students and the sub-story scenario for this game’s school setting!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/e6a185d50145b0861eacc8f77d2cdfc9a01fcffb.png"]Full message below:

Following “Monark,” I was responsible for the student messages and sub-stories.

I wanted to depict the small, everyday scenes that still exist within the school, even amid chaos.

Within the grand narrative of “VARLET,” there are small yet meaningful stories that matter deeply to each student!

Without overthinking it, I hope you'll enjoy the occasional foolish but heartwarming—and presumably earnest—words and actions of the students, as you immerse yourself in the world of “VARLET.”

 

Scenario
ITO Ryutaro

To celebrate the upcoming release, we also received a special comment from Tsukasa Masuko, who composed the BGM for the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/6eabf40a17ed145b950b5256b5d860233c680848.png"]Full message below:

I composed nearly 40 tracks for VARLET, including different arrangements.



During production, the word “VaperWave” even came up, but in the end, the music stayed true to my own style, fitting comfortably into what could be called my signature sound.



My ideal is for the music to blend seamlessly into the game—something you might not consciously recall, but suddenly remember when triggered by a moment. If you find yourself saying, “This track feels like Masuko,” and just let it wash over you, I’d be more than happy.



BGM Composer

Tsukasa Masuko

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/593e2bc6155234ec392df4a39c64b9318957cf0b.jpg"]illustration by 黒須（@kurosususu）



To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’ve received a special message from wotaku, the composer of the opening theme “Shiori” and the another character song “Dominant”![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/eceea9123401bba384d81ef466538f663c2e65fd.png"]Full message below: “Shiori” was created with duality in mind. Aiming for the light, yet trapped in the darkness.



When you lose sight of yourself, you turn back the pages of the past and remember what is truly important—that’s the image behind the title.



For “Dominant”, I wanted to express solitude, so I chose to distance it from today’s popular music.
Aiming for something hard to grasp, I incorporated complex, opera-style melodies.



It is a majestic and powerful song, but I would be glad if you can also feel the hidden loneliness and emptiness within it.


Composer of “Shiori” and “Dominant”
wotaku

―――――――――――

Illustration by フ子（@fucodoku）



To celebrate the upcoming launch, we’ve received a special message from NILFRUITS, the composer of the game’s ending theme!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594467/01616de999296ae9f80e7a8569a1bb0a937d945a.png"]Full message below:

I wrote an original song titled “Camelot” as the ending theme.

The title comes from the city built by King Arthur together with the Knights of the Round Table.

From that image, I envisioned the place where the protagonist and their companions march into battle and return to once more.

I hope this song evokes a peaceful haven shared with comrades who have overcome hardships together, and that you can enjoy it along with the lingering emotions of the story.



Ending Theme Composer

NILFRUITS

notes.title: "VARLET" game controls update
notes.notes:
Regarding our developing project "VARLET," we have received feedback about conforming the keyboard and mouse controls. Here, we would like to officially announce that the keyboard and mouse controls will be available.

In order to enhance the gaming experience for various players, we are currently adjusting the programs before the release.

Thank you for your support of "VARLET."

＝＝＝＝
This isn't a story about finding someone else—it's about finding yourself.

"VARLET"
These students struggle to find their own answer while coping with the difficulties of growing up.
As you get to know them, you'll come to know more about yourself in this school life RPG.
